title: 5a-5: FcaAttributeSource trait + extraction split
description:
## Parent

sutra/30 (PRD: core model redesign)

## What to build

Define the FcaAttributeSource extension trait. Split the current extract_symbol_attrs() into a generic helper (cross-language attributes) and language-specific implementations. RustAdapter implements FcaAttributeSource reading from language_attrs JSON instead of string-matching signatures. FCA engine queries adapters via as_fca_source().

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] FcaAttributeSource trait defined: extract_attributes(&self, sym: &SymbolRow, file_path: &str) -> Option<SymbolAttrs>
- [ ] Generic helper function for cross-language attributes: complexity bucketing, naming convention detection, directory context
- [ ] RustAdapter implements FcaAttributeSource, reads from language_attrs JSON (not signature strings)
- [ ] FCA engine queries adapter registry for FcaAttributeSource capability
- [ ] Regression test: same FCA attributes produced for existing Rust test cases
- [ ] Graceful degradation test: adapter without FcaAttributeSource produces fewer attributes, no errors
- [ ] Old extract_symbol_attrs() in fca/attributes.rs removed or deprecated

## Blocked by

- sutra/31 (LanguageAdapter trait + registry)
- sutra/34 (language_attrs column)"

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review — verdict: needs-attention

**[high] Stale index loses Rust-specific FCA attrs after upgrade** (src/parser/adapter.rs:144-155)
RustAdapter only adds Rust-specific FCA attributes when sym.language_attrs is present. Existing DB rows migrated from the previous model have NULL language_attrs, and the indexing path skips unchanged files by content hash, so those rows won't be reparsed/backfilled. Silent false negatives for attributes like returns_result, takes_self_ref, returns_self until each file changes or index is manually rebuilt.
→ Add backfill/reindex trigger for rows with NULL language_attrs, or a parser schema version that invalidates the content-hash skip.

**[medium] Malformed language_attrs JSON silently degrades FCA output** (src/parser/adapter.rs:145-147)
JSON parse error is swallowed — corrupt or version-skewed language_attrs is indistinguishable from a symbol with no Rust-specific attributes. Hides data loss in convention mining.
→ Surface parse failures as warnings, or make FcaAttributeSource::extract_attributes return Result.
